# Colossus 2 (xAI) — AI Data Centers directory (Epoch AI, accessed 2026-09-17)

Epoch AI data-center tracking page for xAI's Colossus 2.

## Key findings
- **Colossus 2** is an **operational** AI data center; AI chips owned by xAI (SpaceXAI), used by Anthropic, Cursor, and xAI.
- Estimated **1,112k H100-equivalents** of compute, supported by **946 MW of IT power**, at a capital cost of ~$35.8B. Hardware: Nvidia B200 + B300.
- To power the site quickly, xAI installed **natural gas turbines just across the state border in Mississippi** (Southaven), possibly to secure faster approval.
- Epoch AI's tracking shows Colossus 2 as the **largest operational AI data center** at ~946 MW.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — Epoch AI is a well-known, rigorous AI-compute tracking organization (satellite/cooling-equipment models + company disclosures).
- Establishes **xAI Colossus 2** (~946 MW IT power) as the **largest operational AI cluster**, in the Memphis–Southaven (TN/MS) area, with on-site gas-turbine power in Southaven, MS.
- Figures are Epoch AI estimates (satellite/cooling-based), not xAI-disclosed.
